name: OI-flush capitulation V-bounce (1h deeper-flush spot long)
rationale: MECHANISM (H1 on 1h with a DEEPER flush threshold): a slower cadence that only fires on the larger, more decisive OI collapses, trading fewer signals for a cleaner forced-seller-exhausted read. On 1h the ret_Nd 'price is falling' confirmation spans a full multi-hour cascade rather than a single candle, so the capitulation is unambiguous. Counterparty unchanged: a risk engine liquidating into thin books, structurally price-insensitive. Entry: open_interest cross_down through a DEEP normalized floor (bigger magnitude than the 15m variant) AND ret_Nd below a negative floor AND rsi below an oversold floor AND vol_realized above a floor. DISCONFIRMER: strip open_interest — if the oversold+falling combo matches the deflated Sharpe, OI adds nothing; and swap ret_Nd-down for ret_Nd-UP — a profitable long means OI is a price-proxy with an incoherent sign. Fewer, larger 1h trades must still clear ~20bps net.
catalyst: 1h deep OI cross_down + multi-hour price fall + oversold washout
